candidate_dates_unconfirmed.note: NOT USED by the pipeline. Censoring dates quoted in published UK Biobank cancer papers (found by web search 2026-10-05, primary pages not reachable from the build environment). They may belong to an earlier data release than this 2023 export: check against the UK Biobank Showcase 'Data providers and dates' page for this release and against ccfa-workfiles/checks/cancer-cohort/registry_years_by_country.csv before copying them into regions.

how_to_verify: 1. Find the cancer-registry coverage dates for THIS data release in the UK Biobank documentation (data providers and dates of data availability), separately for England, Scotland and Wales.
2. Enter them under regions: registry_start = first date covered, registry_end_exclusive = day AFTER the last date covered (coverage through 2020-12-31 -> 2021-01-01).
3. Fill source_version (data release / application / download date) and evidence (document title or URL and the date it was consulted).
4. Set status to verified and rebuild: python source_code/01_build_data.py --from coverage
Recruitment country comes from the Instance 0 assessment centre (assessment_centre_file in the hospital_cancer directory). Never derive dates from the last observed diagnosis or HES cutoff.
Alternatively supply a participant-level CSV (participant_id, registry_start, registry_end_exclusive) as coverage_file.
